title: Ramanagara + Kanva Reservoir
description:
Final field checklist with scripts for the Ramanagara + Kanva Reservoir vlog.

Use this as your shooting checklist tomorrow. Every scene has an image reference, a Voice-over section and an On-camera section. Under each, tick the shots you record, then use the script box for the corresponding lines.

### Camera settings reference

4K 30fps

Main landscapes, talking, historical B-roll and static shots

4K 60fps

Walking, climbing, moving action and selected slow motion

4K 100fps

Selected splashes, paddle strokes and fast water movement in good light

Wide / Ultra-Wide

Wide for most shots; Ultra-Wide for selected landscape panoramas

Keep these settings as your starting point: Normal 10-bit, WB 5500K, Auto exposure with EV −0.3, and RockSteady+. Use landscape orientation throughout.

For horizontal pans, hold still for one second, pan slowly over 6–8 seconds, then hold still again. Use 4K 100fps sparingly and only when you intend to slow the footage down.

GLOBAL CAMERA SETTINGS
Normal 10-bit, white balance 5500K, Auto exposure with EV −0.3, RockSteady+. Use landscape orientation throughout.
4K 30fps: Main landscapes, talking, historical B-roll and static shots.
4K 60fps: Walking, climbing, moving action and selected slow motion.
4K 100fps: Selected splashes, paddle strokes and fast water movement in good light.
Wide for most shots; Ultra-Wide for selected landscape panoramas.
For horizontal pans, hold still for one second, pan slowly over 6–8 seconds, then hold still again. Use 4K 100fps sparingly and only when you intend to slow the footage down.

Kabhi Shamserabad…

Interesting baat ye hai… ki har naam ke saath is jagah ki ek nayi kahani judi.

Lekin history mein ye jagah kuch aur naam se jaani jaati thi.

Tipu Sultan ke time par iska naam Shamserabad tha.

British period mein ye Closepet bana.

Aur baad mein… ye Ramanagara bana.

Ramanagara naam ke peeche paas ki Ramagiri hill ka connection bataya jaata hai.

Ye ek aisi jagah hai… jise har baar thoda aur jaanne ka mann karta hai.

Milte hain next weekend… ek aur kahani ke saath.

CTA

Aapko Ramanagara ki sabse interesting kahani kaunsi lagi—Sholay ke pahaad, badalte naam, ya Kanva ki kahani? Comment mein batao.

Agar video pasand aaya ho, toh like karein, apne travel-loving friends ke saath share karein, aur aise story-driven travel vlogs ke liye theyashxplore ko subscribe karein.

scenes.notes: Final reminder: Film the main footage in 4K 30fps, use 4K 60fps for selected motion, and save 4K 100fps for one or two slow-motion details. Tick the shots as soon as you've recorded them. Before leaving each location, confirm that the video clips and spoken audio are saved.
